title: Culture methods for VCaP prostate cancer cells
protocol: Prepare 300 µg/ml matrigel solution in phenol red-free DMEM.
Add 2 ml of matrigel solution to T-75 flask.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Remove excess matrigel from the flask.
Warm the matrigel-coated flask to 37°C for immediate use or store it at 4°C.
Warm culture media and a T-25 flask to 37°C.
Rapidly thaw VCaP cell vial in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 ml conical tube containing 9 ml of culture media.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 ml of media and seed onto a T-25 culture flask.
Place the flask in a humidified incubator set to 37°C and 5% CO2.
Warm culture media and a T-75 flask to 37°C.
Remove old culture media from the flask, setting aside 1 ml for use with new flask.
Rinse the flask with PBS.
Add 2 ml of Trypsin/EDTA solution to the flask and place it back in the 37°C incubator until cells detach.
Suspend cell/trypsin mixture in the reserved old culture media and transfer it to a 15 ml conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes to collect the pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in fresh culture media.
Split the cells at a ratio of 1:3 or 1:2 based on initial density.
Add 1 ml of old culture media to the new flask.
Incubate the split cells at 37°C.
Treat VCaP cells gently during handling and centrifugation.
Do not discard floating cell clusters; gently centrifuge and add them back to the parental flask.
Culture VCaP cells with conditioned media (9 mL fresh media + 1 mL old media for T-75 flasks).
Store conditioned media at -20°C for future use.
Avoid using trypsin when subculturing VCaP cells.
